system.name: FuXi-Ocean
system.one_liner: Data-driven global ocean forecasting model with six-hourly steps at 1/12 degree down to 1500 m, whose Mixture-of-Time module weights predictions from several temporal contexts per channel.

content.variant_note: a wide pipeline for panel (a) with two tinted zoom panels below it that open the prediction module (b) and the Mixture-of-Time block (c)
content.argues: Four past ocean states go through shared encoders, a prediction module and decoders, and a channel-wise Mixture-of-Time block merges the four decoder outputs into the next-step state.
content.subject: Encoder, fusion, attention-based prediction and decoder pipeline for ocean maps, with enlarged views of the prediction module and of the MoT selection.

elements.name: X^{t-3} to X^t
elements.role: sequential ocean states fed to the model
elements.drawn_as: four stacks of offset ocean-map tiles cascading down and to the right, one row per time step

elements.name: E
elements.role: shared encoder that transforms each input state into a latent representation
elements.drawn_as: four light-blue rounded trapezoids narrowing to the right, bold serif E

elements.name: F^{t-3} to F^t
elements.role: latent features of each time step
elements.drawn_as: isometric cuboids, pale grey for older steps and bluer for newer

elements.name: S, M and F_S
elements.role: network M turns S into spatiotemporal features F_S that modulate the encoders and decoders
elements.drawn_as: teal trapezoid M with arrows from S below and a teal slab F_S above, a top bus line with drop arrows into every E and D

elements.name: Fusion
elements.role: fuses the four feature volumes before prediction
elements.drawn_as: tall narrow blue bar with rotated bold label

elements.name: Prediction Module
elements.role: captures temporal evolution with stacked attention blocks
elements.drawn_as: teal-blue rounded box, bold serif label

elements.name: ⊕ with F^{t-3} to F^t
elements.role: adds the matching features to each prediction branch before decoding (skip connections)
elements.drawn_as: circled plus on four rows, each with the F label and a short down arrow above it

elements.name: D
elements.role: decoders with skip connections that reconstruct variables
elements.drawn_as: four light-blue rounded trapezoids widening to the right, bold serif D

elements.name: X-bar^{t+1}_{t-3} to X-bar^{t+1}_t
elements.role: four decoder outputs from different temporal contexts
elements.drawn_as: four serif labels with overbar, each on an arrow into MoT

elements.name: MoT
elements.role: Mixture-of-Time: channel-wise selection and weighting of the four outputs
elements.drawn_as: tall narrow light-blue bar with rotated bold label

elements.name: X-hat^{t+1}
elements.role: predicted ocean state at the next step
elements.drawn_as: stack of three ocean-map tiles at the right end

elements.name: Attention Block, FFN, AdaLN, ⊕, ×N
elements.role: inside of the prediction module: attention, feed-forward and adaptive layer norm with residual sums, repeated N times
elements.drawn_as: tall white rounded bars with rotated text and a white AdaLN box, circled plus nodes, skip lines, inside a teal-blue rounded panel

elements.name: MAE, Softmax, V, Top K
elements.role: spatially averaged MAE per channel feeds a softmax update of matrix V; top-K of V gives a selection mask
elements.drawn_as: dashed dark-red MAE box, small Softmax box, then two small tables (V with decimals, mask with 0 and 1) joined by arrows

elements.name: Multiplication, Sum, ×1/K
elements.role: mask times the four outputs, summed and scaled by 1/K to form the final prediction
elements.drawn_as: two tall narrow white boxes with rotated labels and an output arrow

elements.name: Addition (legend)
elements.role: key for the circled plus glyph
elements.drawn_as: tiny circled plus with the word Addition at the top right

lessons.what_to_learn: Keep the overview readable by moving internals into tinted zoom panels below it, tinted in the colour of the block they open and carrying its name, so no leader lines are needed; show repeated time steps as a staggered cascade of rows.
lessons.suits: Forecasting or sequence architectures with several time-step branches and one or two blocks whose internals matter, such as attention stacks or a gating module.

evidence: (a) The main pipeline consists of a shared encoder E that transforms input states into latent representations
(c) The Mixture-of-Time (MoT) module performs channel-wise selection across the four decoder outputs
Our model processes sequential ocean states Xt−3 through Xt to predict bX t+1.

summary: FuXi-Ocean is a data-driven global ocean forecasting model that predicts six-hourly states at 1/12 degree down to 1500 m, built around a Mixture-of-Time (MoT) module. Figure 1 is an overview with two zooms. Panel (a) follows four stacked ocean-map states from t-3 to t through shared encoders E, feature cuboids, a Fusion bar, a Prediction Module and four decoders D, with spatiotemporal features F_S from network M broadcast along a top line, then a tall MoT bar that yields the next-step map. Panel (b) opens the prediction module as attention blocks, FFN and AdaLN repeated N times; panel (c) opens MoT as an MAE, softmax and top-K selection over the four decoder outputs, followed by multiply, sum and 1/K.
summary_zh: FuXi-Ocean 是全球海洋六小时预报模型，核心是时间混合 MoT 模块。(a) 总览：四时刻海洋图经共享编码器、融合、预测模块、解码器，再由 MoT 合成下一步；(b) 放大注意力块；(c) 放大 MoT 的 top-K 选择。
notes: The index labels the figure chart/box; it is a block diagram. The 15 placed map bitmaps are three images reused, read as five stacks of three tiles (four inputs, one output). The dashed rules between panels are drawn as lines, so the digest reports no dashed shapes.
